name: Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps (GIGW 3.0)
summary: Accessibility, usability, bilingual content, security and content management requirements for government websites and mobile apps.

name: WCAG 2.1 Level AA
summary: Web accessibility conformance referenced by GIGW 3.0.

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
summary: Notice, consent, purpose limitation, retention, erasure and grievance obligations for personal data.

name: CERT-In Directions of 28 April 2022
summary: Report cyber incidents within 6 hours; retain ICT system logs for 180 days within India; synchronise clocks with NTP servers of NIC or NPL.

name: Aadhaar Act, 2016 and UIDAI regulations
summary: Authentication through an AUA/KUA, Aadhaar number masking, storage only in an Aadhaar Data Vault, consent for authentication.

name: Rajyapradesh Right to Service Act
summary: Notified services must be delivered within notified timelines, with appeal to a designated officer on failure.

name: Security audit before go-live
summary: Application security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor with a safe-to-host certificate before go-live.

name: MeitY cloud and data localisation policy
summary: Hosting in the State Data Centre or a MeitY empanelled cloud with data resident in India.

name: MeitY e-Governance standards (metadata, data and API)
summary: Standard code directories (LGD for districts), open API policy and interoperability standards.

name: PFMS DBT guidelines
summary: Direct Benefit Transfer through PFMS to Aadhaar-seeded or validated bank accounts, with payment status reconciliation.
